theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_rb_mollify_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u ρ : Euclid n → ℝ) (C ε s : ℝ), Continuous u → Continuous ρ → (∀ z : Euclid n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → (∀ z, |ρ z| ≤ C) → (∀ z z', |ρ z - ρ z'| ≤ C * ‖z - z'‖) → 0 < ε → ε ≤ s / 2 → (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Euclid n) (1 - s), |∫ z, u (x - ε • z) * ρ z| ≤ (ε ^ n)⁻¹ * C * ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, |u y|) ∧ ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Euclid n) (1 - s), ∀ x' ∈ closedBall (0 : Euclid n) (1 - s), |(∫ z, u (x - ε • z) * ρ z) - ∫ z, u (x' - ε • z) * ρ z| ≤ (ε ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * C * ‖x - x'‖ * ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, |u y|
